text: DEMODOCK TAKES A TRAILING TAB AND A NOTICE. `DemoDockTab` gains `placement: "end"`, for a tool offered on every route — it sits after Apps and Colour and never becomes the lead door's label. `notice` shows a short confirmation beside the flask, drawn like its tooltip and announced politely, for an action taken by shortcut with the panel closed. The hub uses both for its new Capture tab: ⌘⌥S saves the visible area and ⌘⌥⇧S the full page as a PNG, without the demo tools; on the website ⌘⌥1, 2 and 3 switch design and ⌘⌥0 flips back, reopening at the same section.
